titel: Thermaalbad Arcen: wellness 23 minutes from Hotel Asteria Venray
omschrijving: Thermaalbad Arcen is a 23-minute drive from Hotel Asteria in Venray. Thermal water from its own spring, six saunas, open from 8.30 am to 10 pm. Prices and rules.
hero-sub: Thermal water from its own spring, indoor and outdoor pools and six saunas, a 23-minute drive from your hotel room in Venray.
hero-alt: The entrance of Thermaalbad Arcen with fountains and flags
v1-kop: Thermal water from its own spring
v1-p1: Thermaalbad Arcen is a 23-minute drive from Hotel Asteria, about 24 kilometres. The water comes from its own spring, 892 metres deep, and is 35 to 36 degrees warm. Indoors and outdoors you relax in the thermal water, on bubble benches, in whirlpools, under an underwater massage or by the waterfall.
v1-p2: There are also six Finnish saunas at 80 or 90 degrees, a steam bath at 45 degrees, Kneipp baths, foot baths and a garden with loungers. Steam cabins, herbal baths and the infrared cabin cost a small extra charge. Pool 1 (indoor) and pool 2 (outdoor) are temporarily closed at the moment; the other outdoor pools are open.
v1-alt: Two swans on the water near Arcen
v1-knop: Opening hours and prices on roompot.nl
tip: If you would rather keep your swimwear on in the sauna, go on a Wednesday or Friday: those are swimwear days. On weekdays you also pay €3 less than at weekends. No bathrobe or slippers with you? In Arcen you can hire a set with a towel, bathrobe and slippers.
g1-tekst: Everyone aged 18 and over is welcome. Bring ID, as you may be asked for it at the entrance.
g2-tekst: Swimwear is always required in the thermal pools. In the saunas you sit without, on your towel.
g3-tekst: Every Wednesday, every Friday and the first full weekend of the month you may keep your swimwear on in the saunas. In December 2026: 5 and 6 December.
g4-tekst: You cannot book the pools and saunas in advance. Last entry is at 20.30; the pools and saunas close at 21.30.
g5-tekst: Towel €4, bathrobe €8, or a set with towel, bathrobe and slippers for €14, each with a deposit.
g6-tekst: Switch off your phone and keep it in your locker. You may not bring your own food or drink; the brasserie serves food until 21.00.
dag-kop: How to make a day of it
dag-sub: Breakfast at the hotel, the thermal water in Arcen during the day and back in the evening for dinner in the brasserie.
m1-tekst: The breakfast buffet is served from 7 am to 10 am on weekdays and from 8 am to 10.30 am at weekends. Then it is a 23-minute drive to Arcen.
m1-alt: Breakfast buffet in the restaurant of Hotel Asteria
m2-tekst: With a 4 or 6-hour ticket you have time for the pools and a few sauna sessions. In between, you can eat in the brasserie at the baths. Every extra quarter of an hour costs €1.50.
m2-alt: Fountains in front of the entrance of Thermaalbad Arcen
m3-tekst: After a 23-minute drive you are back at the hotel. Fancy one last sauna session? The wellness area on the Top Floor is open until 10 pm; Tuesday is swimwear day.
m3-alt: Foot bath in the wellness area on the Top Floor
m4-tekst: End the day at a table in the hotel brasserie. The kitchen is open until 9.30 pm, and afterwards your room is just a lift ride away.
m4-alt: Bar in the brasserie of Hotel Asteria
arr-regel: Your stay, wellness at the hotel, dinner and breakfast arranged in one go. Your ticket for the thermal baths is not included; you buy that in Arcen.
arr-vink1: Free access to the wellness area on the Top Floor
arr-alt: Guest in a bathrobe reading in the relaxation room of the wellness area
kaart-regel: Thermaalbad Arcen lies south-east of Venray, on the Maas. The map also shows three places you can combine with a day at the baths.
kaart-naam: Thermaalbad Arcen, Klein Vink 11, 5944 EX Arcen
kaart-alt: Map of North Limburg with Hotel Asteria in Venray, Thermaalbad Arcen and three other days out
f1-v: How far is Thermaalbad Arcen from Hotel Asteria?
f1-a: About 24 kilometres, 23 minutes by car. Parking at Hotel Asteria is free.
f2-v: How much does a visit to Thermaalbad Arcen cost?
f2-a: On weekdays you pay €20 for 2.5 hours, €24.50 for 4 hours, €29 for 6 hours and €37 for a day ticket. At weekends, on public holidays and in the school holidays every rate is €3 higher. If you stay longer, you pay €1.50 per extra quarter of an hour (as of November 2026).
f3-a: Always in the thermal pools. In the saunas you sit without swimwear on your towel, except on swimwear days: every Wednesday, every Friday and the first full weekend of the month.
f4-a: No. Thermaalbad Arcen is for everyone aged 18 and over, and you may be asked for ID at the entrance.
f5-v: Do I need to book in advance?
f5-a: No, that is not possible for the pools and saunas. The baths are open daily from 08.30 to 22.00, with last entry at 20.30. On 31 December they are open from 08.30 to 19.00 and on 1 January from 10.00 to 22.00.
f6-v: Where can I stay near Thermaalbad Arcen?
f6-a: Hotel Asteria in Venray is a 23-minute drive away, with its own wellness area on the Top Floor and a brasserie. Read more about your stay on Hotel near Thermaalbad Arcen.
